To keep the production lines running, it is important that you meet the following requirements as a production worker: - You are fluent in Dutch or English - You are available full-time - You are available to work in a 2-shift rotation - You are available for the shift from 06:00 to 14:30 - You are available for the shift from 13:30 to 22:00 - You are willing to work in Waalwijk 
 what will you do 
In this varied role, you will be working alongside your colleagues on one of the production lines. Tasks along the line are rotated so you are not always doing the same work. Your responsibilities will include: - Ensuring everything is fully stocked - Performing quality checks, paying close attention to the finishing of the heat exchangers and verifying proper assembly - Assisting with preparing products so the logistics department can collect them for shipment 
 where will you work 
Core Energy Recovery Solutions is a fast-growing international company. The heat exchangers, which are used to recover heat in the form of energy, are distributed and used worldwide.
